[size=6][center][b]~ Cuter Emotes ~[/b][/center]

[size=4]Let's make this cuter!
And, of course, in pastel colors

[/size][/center]This mod makes the emote wheel cuter, in a baby blue color, and with cuter faces!
It's a simple mod, but I wanted to give it a try~

[u][b]Remember it won't work if you have any interface going on that changes the emotes![/b][/u]


[u][b][size=3]By the way, you should also check out GingerNinja7921 Pink emotes, if you prefer them in a cute pink color!
https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18868  - There ya' have it~[/size][/b]
[/u]


[size=5][i][b][center]DOWNLOAD INSTRUCTIONS[/center][/b]

[/i][/size][size=3]· Download the mod in "Files".[/size]
[size=3]· Once downloaded, extract de zip file, it has a folder inside with the name of the mod.
[size=3]· Place it in your "Mods" folder, located in your Stardew Valley folder.[/size][/size]
[size=3]· Run your game through SMAPI.
[/size][size=3]· Have fun![/size]
